response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, 1.0 * mix_count / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM mix_shares) SELECT ms.mix, ms.mix_count, ms.share, ms.share - a.share AS above_average_share FROM mix_shares AS ms CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE ms.share > a.share
